newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus takes over Nethold Poland unit.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus takes over Nethold Poland unit.

text.p: Canal Plus Polska will take over NetHold's pay channel Filmnet Pologne, Canal Plus said in its March newsletter, published on Tuesday.
It said the move would enable Canal Plus Polska to run a wider range of programmes, including German league soccer games, motorcycle races and hockey games.
Lew Rywin, co-producer of Steven Spielberg's Schindler's List, has been appointed chairman of Canal Polska's board, it added.
Canal Plus' merger with NetHold is due to take effect in April.
